title: A Drug-Drug Interaction Study of LY3537982 on Midazolam, Digoxin, and Rosuvastatin in Healthy Participants

sections.abstract: The main purpose of this study is to evaluate the effects of multiple doses of LY3537982 on the pharmacokinetics (PK) of digoxin (a P-glycoprotein \[P-gp\] substrate), rosuvastatin (a breast cancer resistance protein \[BCRP)\] substrate), and midazolam (a substrate of Cytochrome P450 3A4 \[CYP3A4\]) in adult healthy participants. The study will also evaluate the safety and tolerability of LY3537982 with or without single doses of digoxin, rosuvastatin, and midazolam. The study is conducted in two parts. Participants will stay in the research center during the study, which will last about 23 and 11 days for part 1 and part 2, respectively, not including screening.
